company.name: Mthmr
company.shortDescription: Mthmr is the first Card-linked offers platform in MENA, we help advertisers and financial institutions offer better rewards to their clients
company.description: Mthmr is pioneering the intersection of fintech and advertising in the MENA region through card-linked offers, powered by open banking. In a market where advertisers struggle to effectively target consumers and banks aim to personalize rewards, our platform offers a win-win. Advertisers get precise insights on customer behavior, and banks can offer personalized, merchant-funded rewards, boosting loyalty. We've identified a sizable opportunity in MENA, and with our dedicated team and unique approach, we aim to redefine how consumers, banks, and advertisers interact.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,600,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,129,120 to $11,653,280, a 3.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
